title: Celebration Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Celebration is a 1 BR / 1 BA / 3 Guest cottage in Seaside, FL. Allow the warm gulf breeze to sweep away your worries as you cozy up in the charming ‘Celebration’ cottage.
description_expanded: Description21 PENSACOLA STREET1 QUEEN, 1 TWIN SLEEPER SOFAA Classic Seaside Cottage EscapeAllow the warm Gulf breeze to sweep your worries away at Celebration, a charming Seaside, Florida cottage designed for effortless coastal living. With calming coastal hues, crisp white finishes, and timeless cottage details, this inviting retreat blends classic Seaside style with relaxed beach comfort—perfect for couples or small families looking to unwind near the shore.Steps from the Beach & Town SquareIdeally located just across the street and down a scenic path to the sand, Celebration places you moments from the Gulf of Mexico while remaining close to Seaside’s vibrant Town Square. A quaint white picket fence frames the cottage, setting the tone for a peaceful beach getaway. Outside, a cozy side porch swing and sunny outdoor space invite you to relax after a day at the beach or an evening stroll through town.Comfortable First-Level Sleeping RetreatThe first level of the cottage features a serene queen bedroom with a private bathroom, complete with a Jacuzzi tub and pedestal sink—perfect for unwinding after sun-filled days. A stackable washer and dryer are conveniently tucked away, making longer stays easy and comfortable.Light-Filled Living & Kitchen UpstairsUpstairs, the cottage opens into a bright and welcoming living space that doubles as a second sleeping area with a convertible twin sofa sleeper. The fully equipped kitchen offers everything needed to prepare casual meals, while a charming dining nook provides a cozy place to gather and enjoy views of the surrounding neighborhood.Private Balcony for Morning Coffee & Sunset ViewsWhite French doors lead to Celebration’s private balcony, where indoor comfort meets outdoor serenity. This inviting space is ideal for sipping morning coffee, enjoying the evening breeze, or toasting another perfect day in Seaside as the sun sets.Whether you’re heading to the beach, exploring the shops and restaurants of Town Square, or simply soaking in the coastal calm, Celebration offers a relaxed and charming Seaside vacation experience you’ll want to return to again and again.* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES504 square feetPrivate Seaside residential beach access at Pensacola PavilionSeaside is the largest private residential beach community on 30A118 feet or a 1-minute walk to beach accessWasher & dryer located on the ground floorLocated on the west side of SeasideJetted soaking tubWell-equipped kitchenPeacock Alley Linens – fresh, luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to Seaside amenities including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay, Starter amenities providedOnly 1 parking pass per one-bedroom cottage and 2 parking passes for two-bedroom and larger homes are issued. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permit. No pets allowed STR23-002035
